label: TNBC biomarker prediction (Breast-1)
denominator: Multicenter cohort (≥500) receiving neoadjuvant chemo±immunotherapy; biopsy pre/post; endpoint pCR/EFS 3–5y.
notes: TRIPOD-compliant predictive modeling with cross-validation + independent validation. Ethics: IRB, HIPAA/GDPR, germline return-of-results. Bounty milestones: 2w data, 4w model, 3w validate, 1w doc. Kaggle pipeline: 001.

label: HER2 subtyping (Breast-2)
denominator: Retrospective HER2+ cohort (n~600) + small prospective trial stratified by new subtype.
notes: Compare new classifier vs standard for PFS on HER2-targeted therapy. Ethics: trial consent; FDA companion-diagnostic guidance if new test claimed.

label: Endocrine resistance mechanisms (Breast-3)
source: deep-research-report.md / TCGA-ER+ / MSK-IMPACT / GEO resistant models
denominator: Prospective longitudinal cohort (n~400) on first-line endocrine therapy; serial liquid + tumor biopsies at baseline/6mo/recurrence; WES/RNA-seq + TME IHC.
notes: Endpoints: time-to-progression, OS. Ethics: IRB for repeat biopsies; germline vs somatic mutation privacy; HIPAA.

label: ctDNA MRD detection (Breast-4)
source: deep-research-report.md / GENIE cfDNA / prospective trial biobanks
denominator: Nested case-control within adjuvant therapy trial (n~1000); plasma at 6-month intervals; ultra-deep targeted sequencing (50-gene panel) on cfDNA.
notes: Outcome: lead-time of ctDNA detection to clinical relapse. Ethics: incidental germline variants; FDA device approval; MRD counseling.

label: Multi-omic immunotherapy prediction (Tumor-Genomics-5)
denominator: Retrospective + prospective trial cohorts (melanoma, lung, TNBC). Multi-omic: WES, RNA-seq, methylation.
notes: TRIPOD-compliant; PROBAST bias assessment. Ethics: data-use agreements for shared trial data; genomic privacy.

label: CRISPR synthetic lethality (Tumor-Genomics-6)
source: deep-research-report.md / DepMap Avana / CCLE / Project DRIVE
denominator: Meta-analysis of public CRISPR screen data (cell lines) + mutation profiles.
notes: No direct patient data; reproducible containerized pipeline required. Ethics: IACUC for experimental validation.

label: Clonal evolution resistance (Tumor-Genomics-7)
denominator: Longitudinal sequencing study (200 patients) with matched primary + metastatic biopsies (multi-regional sampling); WES + phylogeny.
notes: Ethics: consent for multiple biopsies; anonymized lineage data; GLP for sequencing.

label: Spatial atlas prediction (Tumor-Genomics-8)
denominator: HTAN datasets (≥2000 samples, 21 sites) with spatial transcriptomics + imaging; validate on independent spatial data.
notes: Ethics: HTAN policies; protect patient identity in metadata; FAIR practices for multi-modal data.

label: Functional precision medicine (Tumor-Genomics-9)
denominator: Clinical trial (n=100 refractory metastatic cancer). PDO/xenograft drug panel (50 drugs). Compare predicted vs actual response (PFS).
notes: Ethics: tissue donation consent; CLIA certification if assay guides therapy; IACUC; FDA companion-diagnostic oversight.

label: Organ tropism prediction (Metastasis-10)
denominator: Retrospective study of breast cancer patients (n~1000) with known relapse sites; primary transcriptome vs eventual metastatic organ.
notes: Ethics: de-identified data minimizes privacy risk; IACUC for animal validation.

label: Exosome niche interruption (Metastasis-11)
denominator: In vivo mouse: labeled tumor-derived exosome injection + niche tracking; patient plasma exosome profiling.
notes: Ethics: animal welfare; patient IRB/consent; ISEV standards.

label: Immune TME primary vs metastasis (Metastasis-12)
source: deep-research-report.md / IMMORAD / TISCH / paired biopsy banks
denominator: Paired primary/metastatic biopsies (n=100); single-cell RNA-seq + multiplex IHC.
notes: Ethics: consent for metastatic-site biopsy; de-identification of scRNA lineage; TRIPOD/PROBAST for predictive models.

label: GBM resistance strategies (Neuro-13)
denominator: Preclinical: high-throughput drug screens on GBM PDO/cell lines (n=10). Phase I: small cohort (n=20) testing top combo.
notes: Ethics: FDA IND + IRB; informed consent emphasizing neurotoxicity.

label: CSF ctDNA pediatric brain (Neuro-14)
denominator: Pediatric cohort (n=50) with brain tumors; CSF collection at diagnosis/during treatment/follow-up; ultra-deep NGS.
notes: Ethics: parental consent + assent; minimal invasiveness (Ommaya reservoir); HIPAA for pediatric genetic data.

label: AI radiomics brain tumor MRI (Neuro-15)
source: deep-research-report.md / BraTS / TCIA MRI / TCGA-GBM clinical
denominator: Retrospective MRI dataset (n~1000) with known pathology; CNN on multiparametric MRI; endpoints classification + survival.
notes: Ethics: anonymized imaging; fairness analysis across vendors; FDA review if clinical device.
